move.subject: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message. Our proposed terms are in the term sheet of this message.
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Your on-time delivery averaged 74.9% over the last 4 quarters (sc:70240@2026Q3, sc:70240@2026Q2, sc:70240@2026Q1, sc:70240@2025Q4).
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
Could you confirm lead time days of at most 42?
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Hello,
many thanks, good to have your reply!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €33.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days.
To be fully transparent with you:
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We can do the 42 days lead time you asked for, but rushing things means the price has to be €33.00.
Sorry, we don't send out cost breakdowns, it's just not something we do.
I hear you on the delivery score, we had some hiccups but we're totally on it now!
Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We really want this business - let's make it happen!
Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.
